intro.title: Line Discounts & Price Adjustments
intro.subtitle: Item-level percentage discounts, live GST re-computation, and store margin protection

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 13: Line Discounts & Cart Price Adjustments. MediFlow allows pharmacy cashiers to apply transparent item-level discounts while strictly maintaining GST integrity.
When medicines are added to the billing cart, notice the dedicated Discount percentage column positioned alongside the unit rate and batch details.
Click into the discount input for an item and enter the approved concession, such as ten percent. MediFlow instantly recalculates the line total and highlights the customer saving.
Observe the bottom Totals Bar. Total discount savings are summarized in green, and the statutory CGST and SGST splits rebalance automatically without manual math.
Press F8 to review the net discounted payable on the split-tender checkout. In our final Phase 2 tutorial, Part 14, discover Thermal 80mm Slip and A4 Tax Invoice Printing.

outro.takeaway: Line Discounts: Apply item-level percentage discounts directly in the counter cart with real-time totals, GST recalculation, and margin visibility.
